tha-ap166:1.1: Desapūjaka.] Atthadassī tu bhagavā lokajeṭṭho narāsabho / abbhuggantvāna vehāsaṃ gacchate anilañjase. // //
tha-ap166:2.1: Yamhi dese ṭhito satthā abbhuggañchi mahāmuṇi / tāhaṃ desaṃ apūjesiṃ pasanno sehi pāṇihi. // //
tha-ap166:3.1: Aṭṭhārase kappasate addasaṃ yaṃ mahāmuniṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi desapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap166:4.1: Ekādase kappasate Gosujāta-sanāmako / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap166:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Desapūjako thero i. g. ā-ti. Desapūjakattherassa
